thread:
Sam K: Quick sync — PR #34005 is blocked waiting for an approval. CI is failing intermittently on an e2e: `web/bot-userflow.test.ts › should send message in thread`. Fails on win shard-3 and macos shard-1, but passes locally for me. Any quick ideas?
ci-bot: Build 34005 · pipeline #217 failed · https://buildkite.com/redwood/34005/builds/217 · failing job: web-e2e-shard-3 (job id 78512) · summary: 1 failing test, snapshot mismatch on `thread-timestamp` field.
Marta V: I glanced at the diff — looks like the only assertion change is timezone formatting in the snapshot (offset rendered as `+01:00` vs `Z`). Could be a clock/environment flake rather than test logic.
Rik Patel: Can you paste the failing stack?
Sam K: Sure — truncated: ```
Error: expect(received).toMatchSnapshot()
  Received: "Message sent at 2026-03-17T08:12:34+01:00"
  Snapshot: "Message sent at 2026-03-17T07:12:34Z"
  at Object.toMatchSnapshot (test/web/bot-userflow.test.ts:48:12)
```
Alisha Chen: If it's only timezone, we can either normalize the output in the test (preferred) or update snapshot. Normalizing avoids flakes.
Marta V: Agreed. Short-term: can we do a targeted rerun to confirm flakiness across shards? If still flaky, we should normalize and add a regression test.
Rik Patel: I can run a targeted retry and a local repro. Command I use: `yarn test web/bot-userflow -i --shard=3` and `bk retry-job 78512` (or click retry in the Buildkite UI). I'll kick off the retry now.
ci-bot: Retry requested for job 78512 by Rik Patel — queued.
oncall-bot: Note: upcoming merge window closes in 2h. If this needs patching, try to move fast or request an exception.
Sam K: If retry passes, are we ok to merge with a follow-up normalization PR? I don't want to hold the refactor in #34005.
Alisha Chen: I'd prefer normalize first, but +1 to merge with an action item if retry proves non-deterministic. If you merge, please file a quick follow-up and add a TODO/issue link.
Marta V: Vote: retry -> wait 10m -> if green, require 1 LGTM from Alisha or Rik, then merge. If it fails again, let's quarantine the test and open a fix PR.
Rik Patel: Retry came back green on shard-3, but macos shard-1 still failed (job 78519). Reproduced locally on mac with `yarn test web/bot-userflow --platform=darwin -i` — reproduces ~1/5 runs.
Sam K: Hmm. OK we shouldn't merge until we at least quarantine or normalize. Rik, can you open a quick PR to normalize timezone formatting? Small change + test update. I can hold this PR open.
Rik Patel: On it — will open #34028 with `normalizeTimestampForTests()` and mark the current test deterministic. ETA ~45m.
Alisha Chen: I'll give LGTM on #34005 once #34028 is created and linked as 'fix in progress'. Also please add a `flaky` label on the current failing test in the test-ownership doc so infra can track.
Sam K: Thanks — tagging @Alisha for approval once #34028 is up. Also FYI I added the snapshot diff to the PR comment.
ci-bot: New build started for PR #34028 · pipeline #218 · https://buildkite.com/redwood/34028/builds/218
Marta V: Thanks everyone. Quick checklist: (1) Rik opens normalization PR, (2) add flaky label if we can't immediately fix, (3) Sam holds merge until fix or 1-LGTMed exception.
Sam K: Will do. If #34028 merges before EOD and CI is green, I'll merge #34005. Otherwise we'll coordinate tomorrow AM. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
